Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade four
Subject: General
Strand: FOOD PRODUCTION PROCESSES Strand Sub strand Specific learning outcomes Suggested
Topic 2.1: Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds, part of FOOD PRODUCTION PROCESSES Strand Sub strand Specific learning outcomes Suggested in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade four General.

Key inquiry question: How does direct sowing of tiny seeds enhance food production process?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
Respect: accommodation of diverse opinions while the learners undertake seed bed preparation tasks.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Food and nutritional security as learners grow crops on prepared seedbeds to contribute to food availability at household level.

Link to other subjects:

Learners relate the use of tools and equipment in preparation of seedbed and sowing tiny seeds to concepts of tools in making

work easier learnt in Science and Technology.
